steps.text: NA-0779 (D-0048) STOP 004: Settings > Diagnostics. The runner ARMS the log (on + detailed, through debug_log_control) the first time scr-main is visible and EXPORTS it into the run dir at every teardown (the L4 capture); this scenario then drives the pane: the switch and the pill, the live list, Pause/Resume, the filter, the Copy MEASUREMENT (RULING_NA0779_002 R2 (b)), the Export button, and the switch's persistence across a relaunch.
the runner armed the log on scr-main; the pill must show on scr-main BEFORE any pane is opened (the indicator arm: present iff on)

the live list: the log's own gw.log on / level_detailed events, a gateway command the pane itself calls (protection_status; settings_get is SYNC and never crosses the gateway, so it has no gw.command by design) and the ui.surface transition are the SAME lines the export carries

steps.script: var t=document.getElementById('dl-log').textContent; return t.indexOf('na0779-fv-passphrase')<0 && t.indexOf('FV')<0 && t.split('\n').every(function(l){return l===''||/^[\x20-\x7e]+$/.test(l);});

steps.text: THE COPY MEASUREMENT (R2 (b)): the button places the export's bytes on the clipboard via navigator.clipboard.writeText; the handler records its result in window.__qsld_dl_copy, and the clipboard is read back with readText where the webview allows it
the row above RECORDS the read-back (the first 40 bytes of the clipboard, or the webview's refusal); the writeText result is the R2 (b) answer, the read-back its corroboration
Pause / Resume and the display filter: the filter narrows what is SHOWN only
THE EXPORT BUTTON: the directory the operator chose (the run dir here, never the real HOME -- the isolation bracket), one file, its digest verified by the runner's own capture at teardown as well
launch #2 on the persisted profile: the switch PERSISTS (RULING 002 R3) -- the pill shows after unlock; the contents did NOT persist -- the new session's record begins with gw.unlock

steps.script: var t=document.getElementById('dl-log').textContent; var first=t.split('\n').filter(function(l){return l.indexOf('seq=')===0;})[0]||''; return first.indexOf('seq=1 ')===0 && first.indexOf('ev=gw.unlock')>=0;

steps.text: the runner re-arms the log on THIS launch too (gw.log on / level_detailed appear again by the harness's design); what proves the contents did not persist is the first line above (seq=1 gw.unlock) and the ABSENCE of the previous session's export events
